멋있다.e: to be cool; to be stylish; to be handsome
멋있다.n: cool in style or conduct — admiring people, for men and women
cf: to be cool; to be refreshing
cool temperature or refreshing relief — weather, drinks, hot soup

짓다.e: to build; to make; to cook rice
짓다.n: everyday native verb; houses, but also cooking rice and farming
cf: to be built; to be constructed
passive; roads, bridges, plants or new towns come to be built
active, formal; big public works like roads, bridges, even a nation
to be built; to be constructed; to be erected
passive; a house or building gets built
to build; to construct; to erect
formal; designing and putting up houses and buildings, construction wording
to be built; to be developed; to be created
passive; parks, land, funds or atmosphere come into being
to build; to develop; to create
planned creation of land, parks, complexes; also funds or mood

낯설다.e: to be unfamiliar; to be strange (new to you)
낯설다.n: unfamiliar, new to you; people, places, feelings
cf: looks familiar, as if seen before
to be familiar; to be used to
used to something through habit or experience

횟수.n: count of how many times something happens
cf: number of floors; number of stories
how many stories a building has
count of years spent or passed
stroke count of a Chinese character

빼앗다.n: take by force or deprive someone of something; negative
cf: to take away; to take along
neutral; carry something with you when you go

당혹스럽다.e: to be rather embarrassed; to be rather confused; to be perplexed
당혹스럽다.n: puzzled and unsure how to react; more formal, written tone
cf: to be rather embarrassed; to be rather bewildered; to be rather disconcerted
panicky, thrown off by a sudden event; common in speech

뒷걸음치다.e: to step back; to recoil; to regress
뒷걸음치다.n: stepping back from fear or surprise; also figurative decline
cf: leave a position or step aside, often formal
move back physically or ease off a claim

상업성.n: how profit-oriented or mass-market a work is, e.g. films, music
cf: an ideology putting profit first; usually critical
whether a product is good enough to sell, e.g. produce
the process of making something into a product for sale
